derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and a (presumed) derivative of G4750 (στόμα);
def: to speak off-hand (properly, dictate), i.e. to catechize (in an invidious manner)

occurrences.text: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
